meta.title: Average rents per m² a month for privately financed rental flats, by municipality and by postal code area, and number of rooms
meta.publisher: Statistics Finland (Tilastokeskus), Rents of dwellings (Asuntojen vuokrat)
notes: eurPerM2 is Statistics Finland's average rent per m² a month (keskineliövuokra) for privately financed (vapaarahoitteinen) rental flats; obs is the number of observations behind it. Statistics Finland counts separately paid water and heating charges as rent.

Municipalities also have eurPerM2New and obsNew: new tenancies only (keskineliövuokra uusille vuokrasuhteille), the closer comparison for an ad's asking rent. The table by postal code has no such split.
Rooms: 1 = studios (yksiöt), 2 = two rooms (kaksiot), 3+ = three rooms or more (kolmiot+); 'all' = every size.
Postal code rows with fewer than 20 observations are left out to keep the file small (0 cells dropped).

Statistics Finland renewed the statistic in 2026 (rent index 2025=100). The table by postal code was moved to the archive database with 2025Q4 as its last quarter; the municipal figures come from the current table.
